mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution in periods with declining FEDFUNDS is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening supply chain activity, signaling robust economic growth and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls and HOUST rises, or the interaction effect has a negative coefficient with p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in real personal consumption (GDPC1) relative to the prior quarter signals demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds 700,000 million dollars.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 700000 and GDPC1 declines, or the interaction term in regression is not significantly negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicates strong residential construction activity, signaling rising consumer spending and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution in periods with rising HOUST is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPI inflation exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, triggering monetary tightening and negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending power and triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS falls and UNRATE rises, or the interaction effect is not significantly negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL monthly change < 2.5pp), a decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% triggers positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced discount rates.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change < 2.5pp and FEDFUNDS < 1.0, or the interaction term is not significantly positive.
